name: apple-container
title: Apple Container
description: Manage containers, images, and volumes created by Apple's open-source container CLI.
author: davireisvieira

commands.name: containers
commands.title: Manage Containers
commands.description: List, start, stop, inspect, and remove containers

commands.name: images
commands.title: Manage Images
commands.description: List, pull, tag, run, and remove images

commands.name: volumes
commands.title: Manage Volumes
commands.description: List, create, inspect, and remove volumes

commands.name: system
commands.title: Container System
commands.description: View daemon status and disk usage, and start or stop the service

commands.name: running-containers
commands.title: Running Containers
commands.description: Menu bar item showing running containers

preferences.name: containerPath
preferences.title: Container CLI Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the container binary

preferences.name: autoRefresh
preferences.title: Auto Refresh
preferences.label: Auto-refresh lists while open
preferences.description: Periodically refresh lists while a command is open (uses extra CPU)

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
